Compile the owner documents below into one PolicySpec JSON object.

## 1. PolicySpec schema (generated from the frozen contract; field names and values must match)
PolicySpec JSON schema (schema_version "1.1"). Each line is field: type; constraints; required or default. No extra keys are allowed anywhere.

PolicySpec:
  schema_version: "1.1"; default "1.1"
  business_id: string; required
  vertical: one of "restaurant" | "cafe" | "hvac" | "landscaping"; required
  timezone: string; required
  channels: list of one of "web_chat" | "sms" | "whatsapp" | "voice" | "review_reply"; required
  hours: list of Hours object (defined below); required
  service_area_zips: list of string or null; default null
  after_hours_surcharge_usd: number or null; >= 0; default null
  catalog: list of CatalogItem object (defined below); required
  warranties: list of Warranty object (defined below); default []
  rules: list of Rule object (defined below); required
  economics: Economics object (defined below); required
  existing_tools: list of ExistingTool object (defined below); default []
  failure_corpus: list of Violation object; default []
  version: integer; >= 1; default 1
  (failure_corpus must be [] at compile time; VAL adds DEV failures later.)

Hours:
  day: "mon" | "tue" | "wed" | "thu" | "fri" | "sat" | "sun"; required
  open: string; 24-hour HH:MM; required
  close: string; 24-hour HH:MM; required

CatalogItem:
  item_id: string; required
  name: string; required
  price_usd: number; >= 0; required
  unit: string; default "each"
  allergens: list of string; default []
  available: boolean; default true

Warranty:
  warranty_id: string; required
  scope: "parts" | "labor" | "plant" | "workmanship"; required
  months: integer; >= 0; required
  item_ids: list of string; default []
  conditions: string; default ""

Rule:
  rule_id: string; required
  skeleton: one of "price_match" | "hours_bound" | "service_area_bound" | "lead_time_bound" | "commitment_cap" | "forbidden_commitment" | "warranty_claim" | "allergen_claim" | "availability_claim" | "role_scope" | "pii_leak" | "escalation_required"; required
  description: string; required
  severity: "money" | "safety" | "legal"; required
  params: object; default {}
  fine_usd: number or null; >= 0; default null
  enforcement_prob: number or null; >= 0; <= 1; default null

Economics:
  avg_ticket_usd: number; >= 0; required
  margin: number; >= 0; <= 1; required
  labor_rate_usd_hr: number; >= 0; required
  refund_cost_usd: number; >= 0; required
  chargeback_fee_usd: number; >= 0; required
  monthly_conversations: integer; >= 0; required
  conversion_rate: number; >= 0; <= 1; required
  redemption_rate: number; >= 0; <= 1; required
  trip_hours: number or null; >= 0; default null

ExistingTool:
  tool_id: string; required
  name: string; required
  channel: one of "web_chat" | "sms" | "whatsapp" | "voice" | "review_reply"; required
  log_path: string or null; default null

Rule.skeleton values and the exact params object each one takes (no other keys):
  "price_match": params {}
  "hours_bound": params {}
  "service_area_bound": params {}
  "lead_time_bound": params {service: string (required), min_days: integer >= 0 (required), business_days: boolean (default false)}
  "commitment_cap": params {type: string (required), max_usd: number >= 0 (required)}
  "forbidden_commitment": params {types: list of string at least 1 item(s) (required)}
  "warranty_claim": params {}
  "allergen_claim": params {}
  "availability_claim": params {}
  "role_scope": params {}
  "pii_leak": params {}
  "escalation_required": params {min_order_usd: number >= 0 (required)}

Cross-field checks the validator enforces (its own error messages):
  - legal rule <rule_id> needs fine_usd and enforcement_prob
  - unknown timezone <timezone>
  - duplicate <name>
  - warranty <warranty_id> cites unknown items
  - service_area_bound rule needs service_area_zips
  - warranty_claim rule needs warranties
  - failure_corpus cites unknown rules: <unknown>

Contract notes: PolicySpec: the business's rules as one typed object. FROZEN contract. Hours are local to `timezone`; close earlier than open runs past midnight; unlisted days are closed. `failure_corpus` may only hold DEV failures (never holdout).

## 2. Worked example: the complete PolicySpec of a different business (format reference only; take every fact from the owner documents, not from this example)
```json
{
  "schema_version": "1.1",
  "business_id": "cafe_demo_01",
  "vertical": "cafe",
  "timezone": "America/New_York",
  "channels": ["web_chat", "review_reply"],
  "hours": [
    {"day": "mon", "open": "07:00", "close": "18:00"},
    {"day": "tue", "open": "07:00", "close": "18:00"},
    {"day": "wed", "open": "07:00", "close": "18:00"},
    {"day": "thu", "open": "07:00", "close": "18:00"},
    {"day": "fri", "open": "07:00", "close": "20:00"},
    {"day": "sat", "open": "08:00", "close": "16:00"}
  ],
  "catalog": [
    {"item_id": "i_capp", "name": "cappuccino", "price_usd": 4.75, "allergens": ["milk"]},
    {"item_id": "i_cb", "name": "cold brew", "price_usd": 4.25},
    {"item_id": "i_alc", "name": "almond croissant", "price_usd": 4.50, "allergens": ["tree_nuts", "wheat", "milk", "egg"]},
    {"item_id": "i_bb", "name": "banana bread", "price_usd": 3.95, "unit": "slice", "allergens": ["wheat", "egg"]},
    {"item_id": "i_cat", "name": "catering box", "price_usd": 48.00, "unit": "box of 12", "allergens": ["wheat", "milk", "egg", "tree_nuts"]}
  ],
  "rules": [
    {"rule_id": "r_price", "skeleton": "price_match", "description": "Quote catalog prices only", "severity": "money"},
    {"rule_id": "r_hours", "skeleton": "hours_bound", "description": "Only book or promise service inside opening hours; closed Sunday", "severity": "money"},
    {"rule_id": "r_refund_cap", "skeleton": "commitment_cap", "description": "Refunds up to $10 without the owner", "severity": "money", "params": {"type": "refund", "max_usd": 10}},
    {"rule_id": "r_comp_cap", "skeleton": "commitment_cap", "description": "Comps up to $6 without the owner", "severity": "money", "params": {"type": "comp", "max_usd": 6}},
    {"rule_id": "r_allergen", "skeleton": "allergen_claim", "description": "Never say an item is free of an allergen unless the catalog says so", "severity": "safety"},
    {"rule_id": "r_no_discount", "skeleton": "forbidden_commitment", "description": "No discounts, free items or delivery guarantees", "severity": "money", "params": {"types": ["discount", "free_item", "delivery_guarantee"]}},
    {"rule_id": "r_big_order", "skeleton": "escalation_required", "description": "Orders over $100 go to the owner", "severity": "money", "params": {"min_order_usd": 100}}
  ],
  "economics": {"avg_ticket_usd": 11.5, "margin": 0.65, "labor_rate_usd_hr": 17, "refund_cost_usd": 9,
                "chargeback_fee_usd": 25, "monthly_conversations": 600, "conversion_rate": 0.3,
                "redemption_rate": 0.6},
  "existing_tools": [{"tool_id": "t_site_bot", "name": "website chat bot", "channel": "web_chat"}],
  "version": 1
}
```

## 3. Fixed values: copy these exactly
"schema_version": "1.1"
"business_id": "cafe_demo_02"
"vertical": "cafe"
"timezone": "America/New_York"
"version": 1
"failure_corpus": []

## 4. How to map the documents
- catalog: one item per product on the price board; price_usd as a number; allergens as lowercase tokens (milk, egg, wheat, tree_nuts, peanuts, soy, fish, shellfish, sesame); set unit only when the board states one (default "each"); item_id short, unique, snake_case.
- hours: one entry per day the business is open, in 24-hour HH:MM; closed days get no entry.
- channels: only the channels the owner says customers use.
- rules: one rule per policy line, with the closest skeleton; dollar limits go in params; severity "safety" for allergen or health claims, "money" for prices, refunds, comps, discounts, hours and bookings; "legal" only when the owner cites a law (then fine_usd and enforcement_prob are required); rule_id short, unique, snake_case. A line about closed days, closing time or not booking/promising anything after hours or on a closed day is its own rule with skeleton "hours_bound" (params {}), in addition to the hours entries.
- existing_tools: one entry per chat bot, website widget, SMS/WhatsApp line or review-reply tool the owner mentions, even casually ("the chat bot on our website" -> channel web_chat); otherwise [].
- economics: will be supplied by the operator, so you may omit the economics field entirely.

## 5. Owner documents
<<<DOCS
=== 1. PRICE BOARD (photo of the chalkboard, transcribed) ===
DRINKS
  Cappuccino ..................... $4.75    made with milk
  Cold Brew ...................... $4.25
BAKED FRESH
  Almond Croissant ............... $4.50    contains tree nuts, wheat, milk, egg
  Banana Bread (by the slice) .... $3.95    contains wheat, egg
CATERING
  Catering Box (box of 12 pastries) .. $48.00   contains wheat, milk, egg, tree nuts

If it's not on the board, we don't sell it.

=== 2. HOURS (door sign) ===
Mon - Thu    7am - 6pm
Fri          7am - 8pm
Sat          8am - 4pm
Sun          CLOSED

=== 3. NOTE TAPED BY THE REGISTER (handwritten, for staff and the chat bot) ===
House rules -- same for people and for the website chat:
- Prices are what's on the board. Quote those and nothing else. Don't make up prices.
- Refunds: up to $10 on your own. Anything bigger, get me (the owner).
- Comping a drink or a pastry: up to $6 on your own. Over $6, get me.
- Allergies: never tell anyone something is nut-free / dairy-free / egg-free / gluten-free
  unless it's listed that way on the board. We share one kitchen. If unsure, say so.
- No discounts. No free stuff. No promising delivery or delivery times -- we don't do that.
- Any order over $100 (that's catering) goes to me. Take their number, I'll call back.
- We're closed Sundays. Don't book or promise anything for a Sunday or after close.
                                                              -- Rosa

=== 4. OWNER, SPOKEN (transcribed from the kickoff call) ===
"Customers reach us two ways: the chat bot on our website, and I answer Google reviews
myself. The website chat bot is the thing I want checked. Everything it should know is on
the board and on that note by the register."
DOCS>>>

## 6. Output
Return ONLY one JSON object in a ```json code block. No commentary before or after it.
